svg.title: Clover
svg.text: A 4chan redesign that keeps the boards, anonymity, and bump-order threads, and rebuilds
everything a reader touches: a real type scale, OKLCH color tokens, and 107 test-first
components on Radix primitives. Board and thread data comes from 4chan's read-only JSON API.
